item.title: WANTED: Korean Type Designer
item.description: Can anyone recommend a good independent Korean type designer/studio? I’m looking for someone with the capabilities to create a bespoke 3 weight Korean typeface for a client in Seoul. This is a commercial project and it is urgent! All links, recommendations and advice highly appreciated. Thanks!
